verses.1: Let him not be destroyed; let David not be punished from his own actions.
verses.2: But they are true; speak with truth, and judge the children of men fairly.
verses.3: Even in the midst of chaos, they will still act on this earth. May your hands be strengthened.
verses.4: May the wicked be punished with mercy, and may they be turned away from their deceitful words.
verses.5: It’s like the smell of a snake’s scent; it’s as unpleasant as the smell of rotten wood. It makes one’s ears hurt.
verses.6: Whoever does not listen to the voice of those who are wise and understanding.
verses.7: God destroyed Sinitem in his own words, like broken pieces that were destroyed by Jehovah.
verses.8: They will flow like water; they will move towards it. They will go along its sides, just as if they were being carried along by the current.
verses.9: Just as Shabballu Tames will go down, so too will the wife of Bal-Hazu be destroyed by fire.
verses.10: Before they understand your deeds, we will rescue us, just as life is rescued from destruction.
verses.11: The righteous will rejoice, for he has seen his vengeance come true. He will wash in the blood of the wicked.
verses.12: And a man shall say, “Only the righteous shall inherit the land.” But there are indeed gods who judge on earth.
